summary.en: Track live elements, move them safely and calculate indexed locations.
summary.bn: অ্যারের ব্যবহৃত অংশ হিসাব রাখো, মান সরাও, আর index থেকে অবস্থান বের করো।

notes: These implementations use C17. Compound literals and declarations in loop headers date from C99; C17 does not add automatic memory management.

examples.title: Insert or delete while tracking the live size
examples.explanationHtml: Mode zero shifts values right before insertion; mode one closes the gap after deletion. An invalid request leaves the live sequence unchanged.

examples.title: Traverse and search marks
examples.explanationHtml: Traversal reads each live slot. Search stops at index 2, so it performs three comparisons rather than visiting the final mark.

examples.title: Calculate an element’s byte offset
examples.explanationHtml: Pointer arithmetic advances by elements. The offset formula uses sizeof(int), so the printed truth value stays portable without assuming four-byte integers.

practice.title: Insert into a fixed-capacity array
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..16), n values (-99..99), position and new value (-99..99). Capacity is 16. Print Inserted: 0 for full storage or invalid position, otherwise 1; then print Values:.
hints: Shift right from the final live element.

practice.title: Delete an array position
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..16), n values (-99..99), then position. Print Removed: 0 for invalid position, otherwise 1; then print Values:.
hints: Shift left from the removed index.

practice.title: Find the first matching index
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..16), n values (-99..99), and target. Print Index: followed by the first matching zero-based index, or -1.
hints: Return when equality is first true.

practice.title: Remove every occurrence in one pass
practice.statementHtml: Read n (0..16), n values (-99..99), then target. Keep all other values in order and print Values:.
hints: Maintain a separate index for the retained prefix.

quiz.prompt: Which index range is valid for inserting into an array of size n with spare capacity?
quiz.explanation: The gap after the final element has index n. It is a valid insertion location but not a live element.

quiz.prompt: Why must right shifts start at the far end?
options: The first element is always zero
Otherwise unread values can be overwritten
The capacity grows on every assignment
quiz.explanation: Moving from the end preserves the old source at i-1 until it has been copied.

quiz.prompt: How many shifts does deleting index p from size n require?
quiz.explanation: Every element after p moves once to the left. Deleting the final element shifts none.

quiz.prompt: When should insert reject an update before any movement?
options: Whenever the array has one value
Whenever the new value is negative
quiz.explanation: Full storage has no spare destination cell. A valid append at position size works when space exists.

quiz.prompt: For base B and element width w, where is zero-based a[i]?
quiz.explanation: The first element has offset zero. Each index step advances by one element width.

quiz.prompt: What is traversal time for n live array elements?
quiz.explanation: A complete traversal touches every live element once, regardless of spare capacity.

quiz.prompt: Which operation is constant time in this fixed-capacity array?
options: Inserting at the front in general
Deleting at the front in general
quiz.explanation: Indexed access computes the location directly. The other operations may visit or move n values.

quiz.prompt: After inserting 64 at index one, what occupies index two?
quiz.explanation: Move index two to three, then index one to two. The new 64 occupies index one, while index two holds 85.

quiz.prompt: Deleting the second cell shifts which last live value into index one?
quiz.explanation: Index two’s 36 moves into index one, then size decreases to two. The old final slot is outside the live range.

quiz.prompt: How many bytes separate a[0] and a[3] when the stated element width is four?
quiz.explanation: Three element-width steps of four bytes give twelve bytes. The stated width is part of this numerical model.

keyPoints.en: Array size counts live elements while capacity counts reserved slots.
keyPoints.bn: Size হলো ব্যবহৃত উপাদানসংখ্যা, আর capacity হলো বরাদ্দ থাকা ঘরসংখ্যা।

keyPoints.en: Insertion shifts the suffix right from its far end.
keyPoints.bn: Insert করার সময় শেষ দিক থেকে মানগুলো ডানে সরাও।

keyPoints.en: Deletion shifts later elements left to fill the gap.
keyPoints.bn: Delete করার পরে পেছনের মানগুলো বামে এনে ফাঁকা জায়গা ভরো।

keyPoints.en: Indexed array access uses base plus index times element width.
keyPoints.bn: Index দিয়ে ধরতে base-এর সঙ্গে index গুণ উপাদানের মাপ যোগ করো।

keyPoints.en: An unsorted array search can inspect every live element.
keyPoints.bn: অসাজানো অ্যারেতে খুঁজতে সব ব্যবহৃত উপাদান দেখা লাগতে পারে।

examQuestions.question: An integer array starts at byte address 1000 and uses four-byte elements. Find a[7].
examQuestions.answerHtml: The offset is 7 times 4 = 28 bytes. The address is 1000 + 28 = 1028. The four-byte width is supplied by the question, not guaranteed by C17.

examQuestions.question: Trace insertion of 64 at index one into [72,85,91] and deletion at index two afterward.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Insertion moves 91 then 85 right and gives [72,64,85,91]. Deletion removes 85 and shifts 91 left, giving [72,64,91]. The respective shift counts are two and one.

examQuestions.question: Write the shifting loop for deletion at valid position p and explain its cost.
examQuestions.answerHtml:
for (int i = p; i + 1 < size; i++) {
    values[i] = values[i + 1];
}
size--;

The loop performs size-p-1 assignments before size decreases. Worst-case time is O(n), with O(1) extra space.
